title: Fix crash when rotating device on unsupported channels

timeline.message: Fix crash when rotating device on unsupported channels
timeline.author: GGAutomaton

timeline.body:

The APK can be found by going to the "Checks" tab below the title. On the left pane, click on "CI", scroll down to "artifacts" and click "app" to download the zip file which contains the debug APK of this PR.

#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Reproduction steps:
1. Open a channel which is not supported by NewPipe, e.g., https://www.youtube.com/channel/UClYV6hHlupm_S_ObS1W-DYw
2. Rotate the screen

Also test rotation on a normal channel, the behavior is the same as before.
Uhm, and what if `onViewCreated` has already been called when this point is reached? Then `showContentNotSupported();` will never be called.

reply.body:
I haven't encountered this situation before.

Another possible solution for this issue is to swap the order of these two lines. But idk if `handleResult()` will be called before `onViewCreated()`.
https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/173b6c3f00df02e64151ee642323205400d412f2/app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/fragments/list/channel/ChannelFragment.java#L130-L133

timeline.body: Btw, I don't think I am able to test properly. The crash on this channel is actually fixed, but `showContentNotSupported` should do something: [making views visible and showing kaomojis](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/2e771cd65ab1eff2cb090351a4083d1d129fe53a/app/src/main/java/org/schabi/newpipe/fragments/list/channel/ChannelFragment.java#L573-L576). Could you look into why nothing of that happens? Btw, there is no need to do that in this PR.

<sub> Mod note: don't quote if you don't need to. Or quote only the necessary parts.</sub>

I haven't found the reason yet. I'll try again when I'm free.

timeline.author: GGAutomaton
Stypox

timeline.message: Do not call showContentNotSupportedIfNeeded multiple times
timeline.author: Stypox
